relationships.subject: CeA-PKCδ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic manipulations of CeA-PKCδ axonal terminals in the ZI further showed that inhibition of this pathway reduces nerve injury-induced hypersensitivity whereas activation of the pathway produces hypersensitivity in the uninjured paws.

relationships.subject: GABAergic ZI neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, chemogenetic activation of GABAergic ZI neurons reversed nerve injury-induced hypersensitivity.

relationships.subject: bicuculline
relationships.evidence_quote: the mean oIPSC amplitude in response to blue light stimulation (470 nm, 10 mW) was reduced after bath exchange to 10 µM bicuculline

relationships.subject: CeA-PKCδ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: our results identify a novel nociceptive inhibitory efferent pathway from CeA-PKCδ neurons to the ZI that bidirectionally modulates pain-related behaviors in mice

key_findings: CeA-PKCδ neurons send GABAergic projections to the ventral zona incerta; optogenetic inhibition of this pathway reduces nerve injury-induced hypersensitivity while its activation produces hypersensitivity in uninjured mice.
Chemogenetic inhibition of GABAergic ZI neurons induces hypersensitivity, whereas their activation reverses nerve injury-induced hypersensitivity.
